create_AWQConfig: create an AWQConfig instance with 4-bit weight quantization and a specified group size
build_AWQConfig_from_config: build an AWQConfig from a dictionary containing weight_bits, group_size, and zero_point keys
test_AWQConfig_get_min_capability: test the AWQConfig.get_min_capability method returns GPU compute capability 75 for Turing or newer
get_AWQConfig_quant_method: get the quant method for a linear layer from an AWQConfig instance
update_AWQConfig_modules: update AWQConfig.modules_to_not_convert by detecting unquantized layers from safetensors metadata
create_AWQLinearMethod_weights: create quantized weight tensors (qweight, qzeros, scales) for an AWQLinearMethod layer
run_AWQLinearMethod_apply: run AWQLinearMethod.apply to dequantize weights and perform matrix multiplication with input tensor
